title: UL-21 — Challenge: ElastiCache then HCP as allowed
scenario: Terraform Associate 8a–8d on HCP no-charge only; stop before connecting AWS credentials. Optional smallest ElastiCache delete if you used AWS half.
acceptanceCriteria: Terraform HCP signup uses no-charge plan only.
No AWS credentials connected to HCP paid workspace.
Local Terraform config documents remote backend block for HCP without applying with AWS creds.
Objective 8a–8d concepts answered in notes with official HashiCorp doc links.
If AWS ElastiCache used instead, smallest node deleted same day.
Cost-risk accepted for any AWS cache path.
LabId=ul-21 on AWS resources if created.
HCP organization and project named in notes.
VCS connection not required for lab.
Run tasks / applies from HCP not executed against AWS.
terraform login not stored in git.
Workspaces list screenshot or CLI output in local notes only.
No ongoing HCP bill assumed beyond free tier.

hints.text: Do not add AWS creds to HCP.
Use design notes if paid path required.

solution.outline: HCP concepts plus optional cache teardown.

stopChargesPanel: Delete ElastiCache and AWS tags for ul-21; remove local terraform tokens from shell.

verification: aws resourcegroupstaggingapi get-resources --tag-filters Key=LabId,Values=ul-21 returns an empty ResourceTagMappingList in $env:AWS_REGION
aws resourcegroupstaggingapi get-resources --tag-filters Key=LabId,Values=gl-21 returns an empty ResourceTagMappingList in $env:AWS_REGION
teardown.stillBillingNote: Time already used, transfer, tax, and 8–12h billing lag may still appear. Alerts do not delete resources.
teardown.recovery: If teardown fails, stop. Confirm $env:AWS_REGION is us-east-1 and the caller is not root. Run aws sts get-caller-identity and type that Account value before any delete. List LabId=ul-21 with aws resourcegroupstaggingapi get-resources --tag-filters Key=LabId,Values=ul-21. Delete only those ids. Never delete untagged resources.

beforeYouStart: Read the paired guided lab (gl-21) stop-charges panel before you create anything.
Set $env:AWS_PROFILE and $env:AWS_REGION. Do not use the root user.
